text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
(This right here, today, is where the road
forks.)

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
(Take this first step. Run. Go get it,
Machan!)

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: YAAAHHH!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Hanshin Racecourse roars to life.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Holy cow! That was incredible! Did you
see how
Aston Machan ran just now?!
Tell me you were
watching her!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Sure was! She just kept getting faster
and faster!
The race was over before I
knew it!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Oh man... The Oka Sho is going to be so

awesome!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
You're so right! I got so caught up in
Vodka and
Scarlet that I totally forgot
Aston Machan was
there...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
I'm on to all of you. I know that your
attention
has been elsewhere.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
That's how she opens her post-race press

conference.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
I hear the rumors everywhere, even at
my own
races. And, well... it is a little
distracting.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Everyone's talking about Vodka and
Daiwa
Scarlet. And I can see why.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Two strong and fiery Umamusume who
share the
same races, the same classes,
and even the same
dorm room—they
can't get away from each other.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
And I think it's wonderful. There's
beauty in such
clashes. There's fire in
rivalries.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
But never forget—Machan is the star of
this show.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
And this year's Oka Sho isn't a battle of
rivals,
but a three-way clash. Isn't that
right, everyone?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: With that in mind...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Vodka. Scarlet. Just you wait.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: The Oka Sho is going to Aston Machan.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her open challenge to Vodka and Daiwa
Scarlet
garners a lot of attention...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And the Oka Sho draws near with even
more hype
and fanfare than usual.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Very nice. Social media is abuzz too.
Thankfully,
it's easier than ever these
days to get word out to
lots of people.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Now that all eyes are on me, I'll make
the most
spectacular entrance of all
time.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Vodka found overnight success after
showcasing
her strength at the Hanshin
Juvenile Fillies, and
Daiwa Scarlet is
well-known as her rival.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Their relationship at the academy has
also been
picked up by the media, and
their story has lit a
fire in the hearts of
many.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It seemed inevitable that these rivals
would take
center stage at the Oka Sho.
But amidst all that
attention, a forgotten
third party is forcing her
way into the
spotlight.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It may just be a happy coincidence, but
Aston
Machan is getting more attention
than ever
before.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Now I finally understand what she
meant.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Fireworks I can't set off alone. Fireworks
so
striking and dramatic that everyone
will look up
and watch.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
And then, just when the time is ripe, I'll
take the
stage—a stage set for the
biggest and most
glorious production.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I have no idea how she's done it, but it
seems
she's been building the Oka Sho
up into a
dazzling stage since back then.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
If Aston Machan wasn't a talented
runner from
the outset, her attempt to
insert herself into that
fiery showdown
would be met with indifference.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A sigh escapes me. This isn't a feat that
can be
achieved through willpower
alone.
choice_data_list: （だからこのレースに向けてあんなに……）

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It takes genuine skill of the highest
caliber, and
above all—

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: I will become a super ultra mascot.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: I'll definitely do it. No matter what.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: —a blazing obsession.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Our next stop is the Oka Sho. The cherry

blossoms are in full bloom and their
petals have
started floating down.
